== Complete primary-source region ==
Documented image occurrences follow the preserved sources, not an invented first-publication day.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable import, 8 July 2018]; the card may predate that copy.
* '''Errata, earlier partial''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V) (Errata)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z; no errata mark. <ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-7-extract.pdf|Official Set 9 PDF archived 5 October 2021]], original page 7 (extract page 2).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V) (Errata 2)]]): [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/yavin4massassiruins.png pinned PNG] authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z; exact complete decoded RGB pixels/dimensions match the selected Wiki GIF. No errata mark; supported <code>209_28</code> remains with this full face.
* '''Errata 3, later partial''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V) (Errata 3)]]): October 2023 edition; no errata mark. Header/title typography, frame, icon/badge layout and line wrapping differ from the older partial. <ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf|Official Set 9 sheet, October 2023 edition]], page 7.</ref>
Actual marks are recorded separately from image ordinals in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V9-L-yavin4massassiruins-Set9-2021-2023-landscape-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later complete published partials, rotated losslessly for landscape reading.]] The earlier face uses single quotation marks around the blown-away phrase with the comma inside; the current full/partial use double quotation marks, retained separately in their transcriptions.

Location defaults are rule-derived, not printed zero-cost statistics. Light/Dark bars are separately transcribed, and current explanatory rules are not substituted for historical side-text rules. No new executable ID is assigned. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
